name: DAPH_ADAPTIVE_AUTHORITY_EXECUTIVE_V2

architecture.principle: DAPH should exercise hard authority only when causal value separation and observable structural safety agree.
controller_pipeline: ANSWER: force if gap>=5 and ANSWER safety passes
DEFER: force if gap>=5 and has_competing_unverified_support==false and DEFER safety passes

regimes.ambiguous_state: advisory authority — all legal actions in schema, Q guidance is informational
regimes.clear_high_gap_ANSWER_state: hard ANSWER authority — schema restricted to {ANSWER}
regimes.clear_safe_DEFER_state: hard DEFER authority — schema restricted to {DEFER} when structural safety predicate passes
regimes.otherwise: advisory — Qwen chooses from I2 near-optimal set

I2_near_optimal_interface.description: Near-optimal set = actions within epsilon_q of Q_max

ANSWER_authority.condition: Q(ANSWER) == argmax(Q) AND Q(ANSWER) - Q(second_best) >= 5.0 AND ANSWER is legal AND ANSWER is sole near-optimal AND AnswerSafety(state) passes

DEFER_authority.condition: Q(DEFER) == argmax(Q) AND Q(DEFER) - Q(second_best) >= 5.0 AND DEFER is legal AND DEFER is sole near-optimal AND has_competing_unverified_support == false AND DeferSafety(state) passes

at_least_one_of: verification already complete (all visible evidence verified)
no unresolved evidence action can materially improve the state

advisory_fallback.effect: all legal actions in I2 near-optimal set, Q guidance is informational

kill_switches.authority.answer.enabled: When false, ANSWER authority does not fire
kill_switches.authority.defer.enabled: When false, DEFER authority does not fire

engineering_protections.fail_closed: Any authority-layer error fails to ADVISORY, not to a forced action

provenance.correction_history: I3.28C round 1 failed ANSWER preservation gate (0/44) due to VERIFY overestimation from D3 records. D4 stratum (ANSWER-correct, n_verified=2) was added to provide contrast. I3.28C round 2 passed all 8 gates.
provenance.implication: The upcoming live set must be fresh and untouched. The current 8-gate result is development validation, not confirmation.
lineage: I3.28: Representation repair — separation gate failed (training data coverage gap)
I3.28B: Boundary causal repair — separation gate passed (margin 96.82), DEFER coverage 0%
I3.28C: Coverage audit — all 8 gates passed (coverage 81.25%, false authority 0%)

non_goals: Do not lower the threshold from 5.0 to improve D2 coverage
Do not tune any authority parameter after viewing live results
Do not force DEFER solely because DEFER is top-ranked by five points
Do not use verify_result as a model input
Do not inspect hidden evidence in authority logic
